# MaviSolution

> MaviSolution (legal entity: Mavi Solution Pvt. Ltd.) is a B2B Site Reliability
> Engineering (SRE), DevOps automation, and cloud managed-services firm. We run
> 24/7 monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure-as-code for startups and
> enterprises across India, the UAE, and the USA.

MaviSolution bridges the gap between shipping code and staying online. We replace
reactive, manual operations with software-driven reliability: observability,
automated incident response, Infrastructure as Code, and performance engineering.

Contact: support@mavisolution.com
Legal jurisdiction for service agreements: Chennai, India.

## Services

- [SRE as a Service](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/sre-as-a-service): 24/7 incident response and on-call, root cause analysis (RCA), Service Level Objective (SLO) management, and error-budget tracking to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).
- [Monitoring & Observability](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/monitoring-observability): Real-time dashboards, distributed request tracing, centralized log aggregation, and intelligent anomaly-detection alerting.
- [DevOps Automation](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/devops-automation): High-performance CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible, automated security scanning, and Kubernetes container orchestration.
- [CloudOps](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/cloudops): Cloud cost optimization (FinOps), multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud strategy, dynamic auto-scaling, and disaster recovery planning.
- [Performance Engineering](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/performance-engineering): Continuous load and stress testing, capacity planning, application performance tuning, and database optimization.
- [Web Hosting for SMBs](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/web-hosting-smb): Fully managed hosting with a Web Application Firewall (WAF), daily automated backups, global CDN delivery, and free SSL.
- [Offshore Development Center](https://www.mavisolution.com/services/offshore-development-center): Dedicated full-stack engineering teams operating as an extension of an in-house department, with end-to-end project management.

## Company

- [About](https://www.mavisolution.com/about): MaviSolution's reliability practice rests on five pillars: observability and monitoring, incident management, Infrastructure as Code, performance engineering, and cloud-native scaling.
- [Case Studies](https://www.mavisolution.com/case-studies): An SRE engagement that reduced alert volume during deployment windows through smart alert aggregation.
- [Contact](https://www.mavisolution.com/contact): Reach the SRE team at support@mavisolution.com.
